article.headline: Dar and Rice defeat UIC 68-67
article.description: — Jacob Dar scored 21 points and Jaxson Thompson secured the victory by making two free throws with 0.8 seconds left as Rice knocked off UIC 68-67 on Tuesday.
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Jacob Dar scored 21 points and Jaxson Thompson secured the victory by making two free throws with 0.8 seconds left as Rice knocked off UIC 68-67 on Tuesday. Dar added eight rebounds and three steals for the Owls (5-2). Thompson shot 4 of 9 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 6 from the line to add 14 points. Eternity Eguagie shot 3 of 7 from the field and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points, while adding 10 rebounds. Benny Gealer led the Flames (4-3) in scoring, finishing with 24 points. UIC also got 14 points from Jayce Nathaniel. Dar scored 10 points in the first half and Rice went into the break trailing 32-31. Dar scored 11 points in the second half. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
